description: This file defines common data structures, function pointer types, and macros used in the WAN manager RDK bus component, including base object structures, context link objects, and list management functions.

methods.name: SListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Pushes a context link object into a singly linked list based on instance number.

methods.name: SListGetEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Retrieves a context link object from a list by its instance number.
